newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HKMA to offer two special issues of 28-day bills.
newsitem.headline: HKMA to offer two special issues of 28-day bills.

text.p: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said it will tender two special issues of 28-day Exchange Fund bills to facilitate the implementation of the Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) system in early December.
The two issues of 28-day Exchange Fund bills, each with an issue amount of HK$5 billion, will be tendered on November 26 and December 3, the HKMA said on Tuesday.
Banks can, under the RTGS system, make use of Exchange Fund bills and notes to obtain interest free intraday liquidity by carrying out intraday repurchase transactions with the HKMA.
The decision to launch the two special issues of 28-day bills is in response to the request of licensed banks and the strong demand for short-term Exchange Fund bills, HKMA said.
